articles.title: ‘Gen Z is a force that can’t be ignored’: Dharmendra Pradhan days after resignation
articles.description: Former Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan acknowledged the immense potential of Gen Z, stating that grasping their hopes and dreams is essential for national advancement. He noted that the eagerness of young people surpasses any governmental duties, a point he shared with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who subsequently reached out to the youth. Pradhan maintained that prioritizing the nation's welfare is of utmost importance.

articles.title: Colombia rocked by car bomb blast a day after new President takes charge
articles.description: In southwestern Colombia, a car bomb detonated at a toll plaza on Saturday, just a day after Abelardo de la Espriella took office as president. The army promptly attributed the incident to dissident FARC factions, leaving two security guards injured. In response, President de la Espriella issued a stern warning to armed groups, urging them to comply with the rule of law.

articles.title: 100% tariffs on India soon? US Senate clears Russia sanctions bill; 10 things to know
articles.description: The US Senate approved a bill allowing President Trump to impose tariffs on nations buying Russian energy. India could face up to 100% tariffs on its goods if the bill becomes law. This legislation pressures countries to choose between US markets and Russian energy purchases. India has increased its Russian oil imports for energy security and cost reduction. The bill now moves to the House of Representatives for further consideration.

articles.description: Following a troubling live stream that led to self-harm, Perez Hilton is now hospitalized in Miami, suffering significant blood loss and injuries that necessitate surgery. The recovery process is projected to be prolonged for the famous celebrity blogger.
